workspace.tree/childrenReads.source: loaded-directory reads during the production workspace tree index (pass-through proxy on the children record); one index per children change, none per keystroke

workspace.tree/entriesIndexed.source: entries published by the production workspace tree index; repeated identical values across keystrokes would prove the index is rebuilt

workspace.tree/nameReads.source: entry.name reads in production filterWorkspaceTreePaths during the initial publish and one keystroke (pass-through proxy)

workspace.tree/pathsPublished.source: model paths handed to Pierre resetPaths for the initial publish and one keystroke; a filter that stops filtering republishes every loaded path

workspace.tree/ancestorsRevealed.source: expansion paths produced by production workspaceTreeAncestors for the filtered list; one entry per match, as production emits
